explicitly_allow.description: Irreversible action classes this layer is allowed to loosen. Anything else it tries to loosen is an error.

irreversible.description: Irreversible classes can be tightened by any layer but loosened only when the layer lists them in explicitly_allow.

verdict.description: Gate outcome when an action falls in this class.

match.description: Command, path glob or tool name.

kind.description: Event kind the rule applies to; every kind when omitted.

exact.description: Match the whole command, path, URL or server/tool name literally: no `*` globbing, no basename, host or bare tool name match and, for a shell rule, no extra arguments. `maina allow --always` writes exact rules.

match.description: Command, path glob or tool name.

kind.description: Event kind the rule applies to; every kind when omitted.

exact.description: Match the whole command, path, URL or server/tool name literally: no `*` globbing, no basename, host or bare tool name match and, for a shell rule, no extra arguments. `maina allow --always` writes exact rules.

rules.description: Rule lists accumulate across layers; none can be removed.

protected_branches.description: Branches a plain push to asks (git.push.protected) and a lease or delete push to counts as a force push (git.push.force). Lists accumulate across layers on top of main and master; none can be removed.

confidence.description: Minimum confidence at which the backend's answer is acted on.

window.description: Number of recent decisions the drift guard looks at.

max_error_rate.description: Error rate above which a decision type is demoted.

max_confidence_drop.description: Drop in mean confidence above which a decision type is demoted.

telemetry.description: Opt-ins. Only the user policy can turn one on.

paths.description: hashed (default): the decision log stores paths and other free-form options only as hashes keyed by a per-repo salt. plain: stores them as-is.

log.description: What the local decision log keeps in the clear.

deny.description: Action classes a run in this context never performs, whatever their verdict. Lists accumulate across layers; none can be removed.

wall_clock_minutes.description: Longest a run may take, from its first agent turn to its last review. Unset means unlimited.

max_tool_calls.description: Tool calls a run may make across all its attempts; the next one stops it. Unset means unlimited.

budgets.description: A run in this context stops, with a report, at the first budget it breaches. A repo policy can only lower a budget.
